desc: Our compact Vision Series Cleaning Kit line offers you everything you need to ensure a thorough clean. Its plastic tray keeps all the various pieces of the kit organized neatly inside a durable case that acts like a mini toolbox. These cleaning kits come with cleaning rod sections, various hard bristle nylon brushes, jags, patch holders, and cotton patches. Also included is our durable and detachable aluminum handle with knurling for an easy grip and our mini bottles of Breakthrough® Military-Grade Solvent and Battle Born High-Purity Oil.
